Class MouseManager

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.input.MouseManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, MouseWheelListener, EventListener
public class MouseManager extends Object implements MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, MouseWheelListener
Manager class for handling mouse user-input
